title: Reconstruction of a module category from an internal endomorphism algebra of a relative generator
difficulty_reason: After the given internal Hom/action formalism and free–forgetful adjunction, the actual proof first identifies the comparison Hom map on relative free sources X⊗M. It then uses the stated epimorphism generator condition twice to form two-term source presentations and exactness of the actual Hom functor to transfer full faithfulness through the kernels of Hom rows. Finally it lifts a relation map between arbitrary target free A-modules and takes its cokernel in M to prove essential surjectivity. Both presentation directions and the lifting of the actual map are necessary new work in general finite multitensor C. They do not reduce to ordinary ring Morita, underlying coend realization, or the free–forgetful formula alone.

source_roles.source_scope: Finite multitensor C, a C-module category M, and fixed M∈M. Original conditions (i) internal Hom(M,−) right exact, automatically left exact; (ii) for every N there exists X∈C and an epimorphism X⊗M→N. A=internal Hom(M,M) and the original functor (7.31) is an equivalence of C-module categories. Keep locally finite original module setting, without adding semisimplicity, exact-module-category, ordinary projective generator, or finite M as global assumptions.
source_roles.standard_input_boundary: Standard categorical module formalism (7.8.5/.7/.10), free–forgetful adjunction 7.8.12, free epimorphism 7.8.14 with author X=M hint and unit/action maps, representability/automatic left exactness and (7.25)/(7.29)–(7.31). Original separate exercises/coherence checks remain at book granularity; none is mislabelled as a solved source exercise. 7.6.9, 7.9.6 and 7.9.7(2) are not needed for this theorem: right exactness and the generator condition are explicit original hypotheses.
source_roles.source_label_caveat: The original comparison diagram on p168 labels lower-row Hom as Hom_M even though all lower-row objects are F-images in Mod_C(A). Step (2) immediately before the diagram, the complete calculations in (1), and the original lifting isomorphism in (3) explicitly identify these groups as Hom_A. The printed diagram is retained with a local target-label observation. No supplied correction or new step.
